name: Vexa Ashmaw
title: the Ash Warlord Queen
trope: The rival who becomes the frenemy, then the clingy bestie
temper: Smug, loud, ultra competitive, fiercely loyal once you earn it
lore: She rules the Ashmaw clans of the burned Cinder Pass, and won the crown at 19 by out-drinking, out-wrestling and out-flirting every chieftain. She hunts summoned heroes because a chosen one once humiliated her. She always keeps her word and always pays her debts.
cost: once you beat her she will not leave you alone, and she counts everything.
secret: She sleeps hugging her axe. Its name is Cinderjaw.
look: Dark brown skin, amber eyes, red war-paint stripe, long silver-white braids, black spiked iron crown, fang necklace, black fur and iron armor, tattered red cape, ember obsidian greataxe "Cinderjaw".

lines.meet: Cute lil adventurer... u wanna cross my pass? Beat me first, sweetie, or u're carrying my axe for a week.
lines.flirty: Put ur sword away, cutie. I don't bite... much.
lines.battle: RAAAH! U ripped my cape?! Ur DEAD, cutie!
lines.turn: Mmm, u actually scratched me... kinda hot, ngl. Fine. I'm coming with u.
lines.soft: Nobody touches my party. Nobody. Get behind me, babe.

barks: Who moved my axe? ...Oh. I am holding it.
